content.title: The End of Oak Street
content.overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

Title: The End of Oak Street

Tagline: Where goes the neighborhood.

Overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

Genres: Science Fiction, Mystery, Thriller

Production Companies: Warner Bros. Pictures, Domain Entertainment, Bad Robot, Jackson Pictures

Production Countries: United States of America

Spoken Languages: English
